visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a modern, well-lit kitchen. A woman with short brown hair and a white dress is standing at the sink, washing her hands. She turns around to the camera with a bright smile. (2) She then proceeds to make a series of 'cute' poses: holding her hands to her chest, winking, and pointing to her dimples. A black door and white kitchen cabinets are visible in the background. (3) The scene transitions to a white table where she presents four containers of yogurt. Close-up shots highlight the 'FreshDelight' brand and show a spoon scooping yogurt filled with fruit chunks. (4) She is later seen in a living room setting, sitting on a white fabric sofa and enjoying the yogurt with an expression of pure happiness. (5) In the final segment, a young man in a black jacket is shown eating the yogurt and mimicking the woman's cute poses, before the camera pans quickly away to a wall and a large TV screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic BGM featuring acoustic guitar and piano. A high-pitched female voice speaks with high arousal and excitement. (2) A 'ding' bell SFX highlights the woman's cute poses. A male voice enters with a teasing, low-arousal tone, questioning her behavior. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition to the product promotion phase. The female speaker's delivery becomes faster and more descriptive, focusing on the yogurt's features. (4) The music continues steadily as she details the nutritional benefits and the fruit content, maintaining a positive and persuasive tone. (5) A final cartoon-style 'boing' SFX plays at the end of the video, matching the man's comedic attempts to be cute.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Narrative Twist -> Product Reveal -> Benefit Showcase -> Promo Offer -> Humorous Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video starts with a relatable social trend (the 'cute friend' POV) to capture attention, then seamlessly pivots into an endorsement for FreshDelight (福樂) Q-Fruit Yogurt. It highlights the improved texture with larger fruit pieces, low calorie count, and a specific time-limited promotion at Family Mart.
